name: Doxazosin
mechanism: Selective α1-adrenoceptor antagonist causing vasodilation and relaxation of bladder neck/prostate
dosing: Start 1mg OD at bedtime, titrate slowly to max 16mg OD. Hypertension: 1-16mg OD. BPH: 1-8mg OD
interactions: Other antihypertensives (↑ hypotension), PDE5 inhibitors (severe hypotension)
monitoring: Blood pressure (especially first dose), symptoms of postural hypotension
sideEffects: First-dose hypotension, dizziness, headache, fatigue, peripheral oedema
pharmacokinetics: Well absorbed orally, hepatic metabolism, half-life 22h
clinicalPearls: Always start at bedtime due to first-dose hypotension. Modified-release formulation available
